Cajas National Park: lakes under a cloudy sky
6 January 2027. Baltra and the Santa Cruz Highlands

Breakfast at the hotel.

Transfer to the airport and fly to the Galápagos Islands.

On arrival at Baltra Airport, our guide will meet the group, help with luggage and take you to your transport. From there, you'll head to Santa Cruz, one of the best-known islands in the archipelago.

It takes about 10 minutes to reach the Itabaca Channel, which separates Baltra from Santa Cruz. After a short crossing by motorboat (about 5 minutes), you'll travel by private vehicle across the island to our hotel in Puerto Ayora, a drive of about 45 minutes.

Along the way, the landscape changes from dry, rocky volcanic terrain in the north to green highlands with lush vegetation in the south.

You'll stop in the Santa Cruz highlands to see the islands' wildlife. As you pass through farmland surrounded by wild terrain, you may spot Darwin's finches, the birds that played an important role in Charles Darwin's research and the development of the theory of evolution, along with other species endemic to the islands.

The highlight is a chance to see Galápagos giant tortoises in their natural habitat. You'll visit a private farm that works to conserve the tortoises and their habitat. Tortoises here vary in age and size, from juveniles to adults that can live for decades and sometimes over a hundred years.

Next, you'll visit the lava tunnels, natural formations created by volcanic activity millions of years ago. The tunnels formed when the surface of a lava flow cooled faster than the layers beneath it. Some extend for up to 1 km. Your guide will explain how they formed as you walk through them.

Lunch in the highlands is included.

After the tour, transfer to the hotel.

On arrival, you'll be welcomed and have time to check in and rest. In the evening, you can explore Puerto Ayora, the main town on Santa Cruz, on your own, with its restaurants, souvenir shops and waterfront.

Main stops: Itabaca Channel, Santa Cruz highlands, giant tortoise farm, lava tunnels and Puerto Ayora.

Accommodation: Hotel Fiesta, 3-star.

Meals: breakfast and lunch.
